background_image_description: A minimal sky scene shows a bright cyan-blue expanse dotted with soft white cumulus clouds, the largest cluster in the lower left. The image has a dreamy, film-like feel with subtle edge vignetting and ample negative space.

nodes.asset_description: An open, thick reference book with small, densely set columns of text sits centered against a dark gradient background, its white pages brightly lit. The monochrome palette of black text, cream pages, and a dark cover creates a clean, studio-lit, symmetrical composition.

nodes.svg_description: Hand-drawn white oval ring encircling the word 'GOD'; slightly irregular, double-stroked look with open ends overlapping at the right side.
Short hand-drawn white swoosh underline beneath the word 'WORD'; slightly curved upward in the middle with tapered ends.
